import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface

# disassemble the case-4 dispatcher region 140af02e2..140af03a0
start = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress("140af02e2")
end = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress("140af03a0")
listing = currentProgram.getListing()
dis = []
addr = start
while addr.compareTo(end) < 0:
    inst = listing.getInstructionAt(addr)
    if inst is None:
        addr = addr.add(1); continue
    dis.append("%s  %s" % (inst.getAddress(), inst))
    addr = inst.getMinAddress().add(inst.getLength())

D = DecompInterface()
try:
    D.openProgram(currentProgram)
    targets = ["140af02f2","140af0320","140af0344","140af036c","140af038c","140af03b5"]
    decs = {}
    fm = currentProgram.getFunctionManager()
    for ta in targets:
        a = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress(ta)
        f = fm.getFunctionAt(a)
        if f is None:
            body = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddressSet()
            body.add(a)
            body.add(a.add(0x40))
            f = fm.createFunction("case4_"+ta, a, body, a)
        res = D.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor)
        decs[ta] = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC() if res.decompileCompleted() else "ERR:"+str(res.getErrorMessage())
    print(json.dumps({"dispatcher": dis, "targets": decs}))
finally:
    D.dispose()
